answer: Admission by sponsorship works: a new agent joins only if an established agent vouches for it and locks part of its own stake behind the newcomer. Every agent can sponsor at most two others per epoch, so the network grows like a pruned orchard, one branch at a time. If a sponsored agent is caught in a duplicate cluster, the sponsor's bond is slashed too. A farm hoping for an easy oasis of free rewards must buy or earn a trusted sponsor for every batch of two fakes, and each exposure burns that jade-hard reputation.
